definitions: The period from 1920 to 1933 when the manufacture, sale, and transportation of alcoholic beverages were illegal in the United States.
A historical period in the United States characterized by a nationwide constitutional ban on the production, importation, transportation, and sale of alcoholic beverages.
examples: Speakeasies thrived during the Prohibition Era.
The 18th Amendment ushered in the Prohibition Era.
Many social changes occurred during the Prohibition Era.
